Mapping/labels: https://www.inegi.org.mx/contenidos/programas/ensu/datosabiertos/conjunto_de_datos_ensu_2024_1t_csv.zip (sha256 9361396d16532018474e62d3281ccf2dac0c006c6d4b10c3fd83bc3cb5c8bd39), conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0324/diccionario_de_datos/diccionario_de_datos_ensu_cb_0324.csv (variable labels) and catalogos/bp3_*.csv (value labels). Rights: instrument_rights_register.csv INEGI row verdict=ship (Ben 2026-09-23, irw#2381 R01; INEGI Terminos de libre uso, attribution only), applied not re-derived; credit condition applied in public_note.
note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #20, Q1 2024 Government Performance) keeps INEGI columns bp3_1_01..bp3_1_16, bp3_1_99, bp3_2, bp3_2a from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0324.csv (import delimited case(lower)) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step). mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's data dictionary labels each BP3_* column (e.g. BP3_1_02 'Problemas que enfrenta la ciudad: Deficiencias en la red publica de drenaje'; BP3_1_16 '...: Ninguno'; BP3_2 'Efectividad del gobierno de su ciudad para resolver problemas'; BP3_2A 'Conocimiento del gobierno ha implementado actividades o programas para prevenir la violencia y/o la delincuencia'), 19/19 agree in content with the questionnaire item carrying the same code number (3.1 options 01-16, 99; 3.2; 3.2a). Cross-check (route 9 style): all 19 live item vectors reproduce the raw INEGI Q1 2024 CSV cell for cell after the .do's recodes -- 40/40 item x level counts (e.g. bp3_1_01 0/1 = 9214/14808, bp3_1_99 0/1 = 23970/52, bp3_2 1/2/3/4 = 1024/7002/9981/5408, bp3_2a 1/2 = 8316/14896); bp3_2=9 (170) and bp3_2a=9 (810) set missing by the .do. Routing (not a defect): bp3_2 is blank in the raw file for 437 = 385 (bp3_1_16 Ninguno) + 52 (bp3_1_99 NS/NR), matching the printed skip 'SI SE REGISTRO CODIGO 16 ... O 99 ..., PASE A 3.2a'. Words: item_text / section_prompt are the administered questionnaire wording (text_source=study_materials). The 3.1, 3.2 and 3.2a stems and 3.2a/3.2 options are in the PDF text layer; 3.1 options 02, 05, 06, 14 and the word 'deficiente' of 13 are missing from the text layer and were transcribed from 200/300 dpi renders of p.4 (spot-check those) -- each agrees with INEGI's dictionary label for the same code. Kept as printed: '(CIUDAD)' fill, 'etcetera' in 12 (dictionary says 'etc.'). Normalised: double space in 06 'limpia y  recoleccion' collapsed; line wraps joined with a space. Stripped: question numbers, option codes, dot leaders, 'ESPECIFIQUE' blank after Otro, interviewer directions (MUESTRE LA TARJETA 'C'; CIRCULE LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES / UN SOLO CODIGO; the 3.1 skip instruction). Tarjeta C (the show card) is not in the questionnaire zip and was not transcribed. Structure: section _1 = 3.1 (stem in section_prompt, option wording in item_text), _2 = 3.2, _3 = 3.2a (stems in item_text); instructions blank -- Section III has no read-aloud introduction. Options: bp3_1_* are 0/1 flags for a circled code; option_text is INEGI's catalogo label ('0' = 'No se declaro como opcion afirmativa', '1' = 'Si', identical in all 17 catalogos), not questionnaire print. bp3_2 1-4 = Muy/Algo/Poco/Nada efectivo and bp3_2a 1/2 = Si/No are printed in the questionnaire and identical in catalogos bp3_2.csv / bp3_2a.csv; code 9 'No sabe / no responde' has no row (set missing by the .do). Every level each item's respondents used has an option row. Step 3b: live items match this question block exactly (19 = 17 + 1 + 1); dictionary Description ('Resident evaluations of local and federal government security performance') overstates it -- 3.1 is a city-problems checklist, and 3.2/3.2a ask only about the (CIUDAD) government, not the federal one; the dictionary Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while the data and wording are the 2024 Q1 wave (file suffix 0324). English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation); INEGI publishes no English questionnaire.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2024, primer trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section III (questions 3.1-3.2a) from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions, used INEGI's data-catalogue labels for the 0/1 checklist codes, and added an English translation of its own; INEGI does not endorse this item text.
